WHAT IS THAT?|audio = HardcoreWave45-2.ogg|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] on Wave 45 ([[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Void Reaver''' is the final boss of [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode and [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] mode that spawns on Wave 45 and 50 respectively. It has the highest health out of all enemies that appeared before it, but it is also the slowest until ''Void Deathwish'' is activated. In [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] mode, it debuts alongside the [[Void Caster]], which acts as a support for the '''Void Reaver''', reviving it, summoning in enemies and giving it a shield. The '''Void Reaver''' has six abilities: #The first is ''Cursed Blade'', where the '''Void Reaver''' slashes its sword forward, applying a 100% [[Fatigue Debuff]] and 20% [[Scared Debuff]] to towers. For towers hit up close, the debuff values are doubled. In both cases the debuffs will last 8 seconds. Additionally, the attack also summons in six [[Blessed]] [[Soul]]s. #The second is ''Void Judgement'', in which the '''Void Reaver''' raises its sword into the sky and causes beams to appear on six towers, cursing them until the '''Void Reaver''' reaches 0 health. #The third is ''Unnerving Gaze'' which has the '''Void Reaver''' slam its sword into the ground, causing three portals to appear that later turn into a [[Void Eye]], an enemy which will fire projectiles at towers and units, stunning and damaging them. #The fourth is the second phase for the '''Void Reaver''' is ''Void's Wrath'', triggered once it reaches 60% of its health. In all modes, this unlocks its next ability, ''Void Rupture'', but in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] and [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] modes, it will also gain a 25% speed boost and in [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] specifically, it also summons in the [[Void Caster]]. Entering its second phase also gives it a new appearance. #The fifth ability that is unlocked after ''Void Wrath'' is ''Void Rupture''. It starts off with the '''Void Reaver''' slamming its sword at towers three times, stunning them for 5 seconds and applying a 25% [[Fatigue Debuff]]. Afterwards, it will start to charge up its sword which, if not stopped, this will cause it to stun all towers for 12 seconds and deal 100,000 damage to units. If 300,000 damage is dealt to it during that, the attack will get parried and the '''Void Reaver''' will become temporarily immobile. #The sixth ability is its third phase, the ''Void Deathwish''. Its triggering method depends on the mode, with [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode requiring its health to be reduced to 15%, so 180,000 of its health, while in [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] mode, it will happen once the [[Void Caster]] is killed. This phase sets its speed to 4.5 and it will stop using its abilities. ==Logbook Description== "''Being the right hand and most prized giant created by the Void Caster and enhanced by Lord Exo, the Void Reaver is the epitome of the Void. Its power alone makes it one of the strongest creatures conceived. As it crossed the battlefield alongside Void Caster during the battle of the Old World, the Void Reaver slew countless Two X’s warriors. Many of the giants fell during the battle, making them incredibly rare to find. As it walks, it contaminates the ground for the Void flora to grow. Where the Void Reaver walks, the Void takes root, the soil blooming with the pale, quiet flowers that mark land the eternal nothing has claimed. No one has ever seen the limit of its strength, because nothing has ever come close to using it. The battle of the Old World ended before the Void Reaver was truly tested, and Void Caster has not since found someone worthy for it to target. What it is truly capable of still remains a question. Above all, the Void Reaver answers only to her, and it falls still the moment her song reaches it.''" ==Appearance== The '''Void Reaver''' has dark purple skin and six eyes. It wears black and purple body armor covering its entire body and a mask covering most of its head. There is a purple hexagon on its chest. The '''Void Reaver''' has purple spikes and horns on its body, which once in ''Void Wrath'', are accompanied by even more pink spikes. Upon entering ''Void Wrath'' it will also rip its mask off. It carries a large broadsword to attack towers with. ==Strategy== *As with most major bosses, high DPS towers such as the [[Juggernaut]], [[Pursuit]], [[Ranger]], [[Turret]] and [[Accelerator]] are recommended to deal with the '''Void Reaver'''. **The [[Commander]], [[Medic]] and [[DJ Booth]] can also be used to boost these towers. *As the '''Void Reaver''' has the [[Boss]] attribute, meaning majority of stalling options are unable to stall it. **The [[Freezer]], [[Frost Blaster]] and [[Sledger]] can only chill the '''Void Reaver''' instead of freezing it. **The [[Electroshocker]], [[Tesla]] and [[Warden]] also cannot stun it, and have a weaker slowing effect on it. *Make sure to sell any [[Farm]]s to maximize the number of towers attacking the '''Void Reaver'''. They do not produce any income anymore, still count towards your tower limit, and can be replaced by a more useful tower. *The '''Void Reaver's''' ''Void's Deathwish'' ability activates at 180,000 health in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode or if the [[Void Caster]] is killed in [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] mode, making it significantly faster, running past defenses. **Replace your towers quickly when the '''Void Reaver''' gets out of range. **Use towers with long ranges like the [[Ranger]] as you will no need to waste cash replacing it. **Using high health units such as [[Riot Guard]] is recommended. **The [[Pursuit]] is also very effective as you can reposition it. *The '''Void Reaver''' can curse towers, which effectively stuns them until its health goes down to 0. **For more important towers, it is generally recommended to sell and rebuy them. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} V2.0.0Thumbnail.png|'''Void Reaver''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} HardcoreCountdown23Hour.png|'''Void Reaver''' on the game icon.
